description: Land Title Settlement Dept - T.R. Kurukuththala, udunuwara D/S/D, kandy District ( 25-14-204-00097)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively about the declaration of land title determinations for specific parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, owner names, extents, and nature of title. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, which covers land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized non-land administrative matters.
